value: Feature Stay at the Grand Hotel, Nuwara Eliya - established in 1891, a National Heritage Property with a modern approach to sustainability (single-use plastic eliminated), including high tea
Hands-on Sri Lankan craft traditions: palm leaf writing and wood and stone carving at Ridi Vihara, and pottery making at Muriya Kadawala village
Exclusive look at rural life in Ambagasthenna with tea plantation owner Mr Thilina: tea plantation, sustainable farming and a home-cooked lunch
Safari in Minneriya National Park to see wild Sri Lankan elephants, macaques and spot-billed pelicans
Cultural triangle with a local leader: Sigiriya (Lion Rock) climb, Polonnaruwa by bicycle, and Kandy's Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic

Scenic train ride from Kandy towards Nuwara Eliya (subject to rail availability)
Welcome dinner with complimentary cocktails and a farewell dinner at a modern Sri Lankan spice-focused restaurant in Colombo
